summary.en: Deliver the mysterious old man, the kid, and their robot to Volturn in the Askonia system. Avoid patrols; they may be wanted by the authorities.
summary.zh: 把神秘老人，小伙子，以及他们的机器人送到位于 Askonia 星系的 Volturn 行星上。避开巡逻队，你的乘客可能已被通缉。

summary.en: Pick up Jethro Bornanew from Gilead.
summary.zh: 从 Gilead 接走 Jethro Bornanew。

summary.en: You've acquired ground-forces security codes for %s. Having these allows for much better raid planning and will reduce marine casualties by %s.
summary.zh: 你已获得 %s 地面部队的安全码，这意味着你可更好地制定劫掠计划，从而降低 %s 陆战队员的伤亡。

summary.en: Find Bornanew. His last mission was the infiltration of a Pather cell; someone must known something about where he is.
summary.zh: 袭击了 Mazalot 并且引发了卢德教徒起义

summary.en: Visit the six shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. The pilgrimage is traditionally completed by returning to Gilead, in the Canaan system.
summary.zh: 拜访 朝圣者之路 上的六处 圣地。朝圣之道的传统终点是回到 Canaan 星系的 Gilead。

summary.en: Recover information about a Hegemony fleet last seen in a Tri-Tachyon held system during the first AI War, more than a hundred cycles ago. The fleet is rumored to have been carrying a planetkiller weapon.
summary.zh: 收集关于 一百多星历年前，在 第一次 AI 战争中 消失在 速子科技 控制区域的 霸主 舰队的信息。传言该舰队携带着一枚 行星杀手。

summary.en: Go to Eventide in the Samarra system.
summary.zh: 去 Samarra 星系内的 Eventide。
前往 Galatia 学院，并与新任院长

summary.en: Find a way to decrypt the ANDRADA files.
summary.zh: 设法解密 ANDRADA 文件。

summary.en: Dolos Macario has made the first move. You must choose how to respond.
summary.zh: Dolos Macario 已经先出手了。你必须决定如何应对。

summary.en: Meet Yannick Ram at his safehouse on Volturn. He has a plan to save the Sindrian Diktat from itself.
summary.zh: 在 Volturn 的安全屋会见 Yannick Ram。他有一个让辛达强权免于自我毁灭的计划。
